ideas.title: Twin Deck Solitaire
ideas.novelty_gate_note: Search for 'stacked two-layer peg solitaire board vertical transfer move between decks' returned only standard single-board peg-solitaire material and unrelated math papers, no shipped stacked-board transfer-move product. Claim not contradicted.
ideas.geometric_tooling_note: 4 of 5 must_survive ranks (1,2,4,5) came back 'inconclusive' from evaluation_report.json purely because score_build.py's compile_conditions() reads geometric.get('inputs'), which this turn's IDEAS.json schema never populates (it uses 'parts'/'thresholds' instead) -- a scoring-harness wiring bug, not a geometry defect. Per-rubric they still receive 0.5 geometric credit each (inconclusive), which is reflected in geometric_fidelity=0.6 exactly as reported. Independent read of project/main.py confirms all 4 conditions are numerically satisfied: 30.0mm board-to-board gap (GAP=30.0, threshold 25-35mm), 0.0mm hole-alignment offset (both boards built from the same cross_positions() call, threshold max 1.0mm), and 0.3mm radial peg clearance (PEG_D=11.4 vs HOLE_D=12.0, exact match to spec).
ideas.printability_disagreement_note: Independent printability_0_10 (evaluation_report.json) = 7.68 (class 'hard', risk factors: 70 disconnected mesh components, 10.7% unsupported overhang) vs. pipeline's own review_fix.printability = 10 (job_result.json, 'printability-only' mode, 0 iterations). These 70 components are the correct, intended outcome here (2 boards + 4 posts + 64 loose pegs = 70 separate bodies, matching the expected_components=70 pass), so this is not the fusion-signature failure mode BOARD.md warns about -- it's the review_fix grader being blind to a risk factor (overhang/multi-body print planning) that the independent scorer catches.
ideas.unscored_deviation_note: cad_prompt specified blind bores (15mm deep) at the 4 post insertion points; project/main.py's make_board() cuts BORE_D=7.85 through the full board thickness (T+2mm), so insertion pins poke ~3mm past each board's outer face. Does not affect any of the 5 must_survive checks but is a real, unscored translation gap worth tracking in CAD_GRAMMAR.md.
